seed: A screenshot open in a laptop window (1200 by 720), marked up until the layers list has grown to its full height, which is what a document looks like after ten minutes of work. Pick a rectangle, a piece of text, a measurement and a zoom callout in turn, and read the dock's own offsets back rather than trusting a picture. The claim, one waitFor per selection so the walk FAILS rather than reports: the section named after the thing you picked is whole on screen without anyone scrolling. One exception, stated in the steps: a plain rectangle no longer HAS a section of its own since the parts list took its one row, so what it claims is that the section its settings did move into is on screen. A measurement claims the whole section like everything else, and then opens the Details fold to prove the numbers that fold away are one click from where they were.

steps.note: the document every claim below is read off: a screenshot with a measurement, four rectangles, a label and a zoom callout on it, so the layers list is at its full height.

THE TEST for a rectangle. Since the parts list landed a plain rectangle has no section of its own at all: its one row, the outline width, became a part inside Appearance. So the claim is that Appearance is in dockInView whole, which is where everything a rectangle owns now is.
the same for a piece of text, whose own section is the tallest of the three that can fit.

THE TEST for a measurement, and the one this walk used to have to give up on: the section was 470pt tall against a 344pt slot, so no ordering could fit it. Its settings now read one to a line and its read-only numbers fold away, and the whole section is in dockInView.
and nothing was taken away: one click on Details puts From, To, Distance, Units and the exact spec line back, which is what makes the trim a fold rather than a deletion.
the same for a zoom callout: both its rows, Magnification and the shape picker.
an arrow is the one shape that still has a section of its own, because it carries a caption and a head the parts list does not hold. Whole on screen too.
